rules.title: Root account used recently
rules.recommendation: Root was used {days_since_use} day(s) ago. Use IAM users or roles with least privilege instead of root.

rules.title: Root account MFA not enabled
rules.recommendation: Enable virtual or hardware MFA on the root account immediately.

rules.title: Console IAM user without MFA
rules.recommendation: Enable MFA for {resource_id} or disable console access if it is not needed.

rules.title: Access key not rotated
rules.recommendation: Rotate access key {resource_id} ({key_age_days} days old) and update the applications using it.

rules.title: IAM password policy weak or missing
rules.recommendation: Configure the password policy: at least {min_password_length} characters, upper/lower/number/symbol, expiry within {max_password_age_days} days, reuse prevention of {min_password_reuse_prevention}.

rules.title: IAM user has administrative managed policy
rules.recommendation: Replace {policy_name} on {resource_id} with least-privilege policies.

rules.title: Role inline policy allows */*
rules.recommendation: Replace inline policy {policy_name} on {resource_id} with a least-privilege policy.

rules.title: IAM user console credentials unused
rules.recommendation: Disable console access for {resource_id} (unused {days_unused} days) or remove the user.

rules.title: IAM user has inline policies
rules.recommendation: Convert the inline policies on {resource_id} to managed policies.

rules.title: Role trust policy allows any AWS principal
rules.recommendation: Restrict the trust policy of {resource_id} to specific account IDs or services.

rules.title: S3 public access not fully blocked
rules.recommendation: Enable all four public access block settings on {resource_id}.

rules.title: S3 bucket policy allows public access
rules.recommendation: Remove the public principal from the policy on {resource_id}.

rules.title: S3 bucket default encryption missing or weak
rules.recommendation: Enable SSE-S3 (AES256) or SSE-KMS default encryption on {resource_id}.

rules.title: S3 versioning not enabled
rules.recommendation: Enable versioning on {resource_id}.

rules.title: S3 access logging not enabled
rules.recommendation: Enable server access logging on {resource_id} to a dedicated logging bucket.

rules.title: S3 bucket has no lifecycle policy
rules.recommendation: Define lifecycle rules on {resource_id} that match your data retention policy.

rules.title: Important S3 bucket has no cross-region replication
rules.recommendation: Consider enabling cross-region replication on {resource_id} for disaster recovery.

rules.title: Security group allows all inbound traffic from the internet
rules.recommendation: Remove the all-traffic rule on {resource_id} and allow only required ports.

rules.title: Security group exposes a sensitive port to the internet
rules.recommendation: Restrict port {port} ({service}) on {resource_id} to specific trusted IP ranges.

rules.title: Security group opens a large port range to the internet
rules.recommendation: Replace the broad port range {from_port}-{to_port} on {resource_id} with the specific ports required.

rules.title: Security group allows all outbound traffic
rules.recommendation: Restrict egress on {resource_id} to required destinations.

rules.title: Default security group has inbound rules
rules.recommendation: Remove all rules from the default security group {resource_id}.

rules.title: Security group not attached to any resource
rules.recommendation: Delete unused security group {resource_id}.

rules.title: CloudTrail missing or trail not multi-region
rules.recommendation: Create a multi-region CloudTrail trail, or convert {resource_id} to multi-region.

rules.title: No multi-region CloudTrail trail in account
rules.recommendation: Enable a multi-region CloudTrail trail.

rules.title: CloudTrail log file validation disabled
rules.recommendation: Enable log file validation on {resource_id}.

rules.title: CloudTrail not encrypted with KMS
rules.recommendation: Configure a customer-managed KMS key for {resource_id}.

rules.title: CloudTrail not delivering to CloudWatch Logs
rules.recommendation: Configure {resource_id} to deliver logs to a CloudWatch Logs group.

rules.title: CloudTrail S3 bucket not blocking public access
rules.recommendation: Enable all public access block settings on CloudTrail bucket {resource_id}.

rules.title: CloudTrail not logging all management events
rules.recommendation: Set the event selectors on {resource_id} to include all read and write management events.

rules.title: GuardDuty not enabled
rules.recommendation: Enable GuardDuty (detector {resource_id}) in all active regions.

rules.title: GuardDuty finding frequency is six hours
rules.recommendation: Change the finding publishing frequency of {resource_id} to {recommended_frequency}.

rules.title: Active GuardDuty finding
rules.recommendation: Investigate GuardDuty finding {resource_id} (type {guardduty_type}).

rules.title: GuardDuty S3 Protection not enabled
rules.recommendation: Enable S3 Protection on GuardDuty detector {resource_id}.

rules.title: KMS key rotation not enabled
rules.recommendation: Enable automatic annual rotation for {resource_id}.

rules.title: KMS key policy allows any AWS principal
rules.recommendation: Restrict the key policy of {resource_id} to specific IAM roles and users.

rules.title: KMS key pending deletion
rules.recommendation: Confirm no service uses {resource_id} before it is deleted on {deletion_date}.

rules.title: Secret rotation not enabled
rules.recommendation: Enable automatic rotation for {resource_id} with a rotation Lambda.

rules.title: Secret not accessed recently
rules.recommendation: Delete {resource_id} (unused {days_unused} days) or confirm it is still needed.

rules.title: Secret uses the AWS-managed key
rules.recommendation: Encrypt {resource_id} with a customer-managed KMS key.

rules.title: Lambda uses a deprecated runtime
rules.recommendation: Migrate {resource_id} off {runtime}: python3.12, nodejs22.x, java21, or provided.al2023 for Go.

rules.title: Lambda env var may hold a plaintext secret
rules.recommendation: Move env var {env_var} of {resource_id} to Secrets Manager or SSM SecureString and read it at runtime.

rules.title: Lambda has no dead-letter queue
rules.recommendation: Configure an SQS queue or SNS topic as the dead-letter queue for {resource_id}.

rules.title: Lambda resource policy allows any principal
rules.recommendation: Restrict the resource policy of {resource_id} to specific accounts, services or ARNs, with aws:SourceArn/aws:SourceAccount conditions.

rules.title: Lambda does not enforce code signing
rules.recommendation: Create an AWS Signer profile and code signing configuration and associate it with {resource_id}.

rules.title: Lambda execution role name suggests admin access
rules.recommendation: Review the policies on {role_name} used by {resource_id} and reduce them to least privilege.

rules.title: RDS instance publicly accessible
rules.recommendation: Set PubliclyAccessible=false on {resource_id}; reach it through VPN, bastion or PrivateLink only.

rules.title: RDS instance storage not encrypted
rules.recommendation: Snapshot {resource_id}, copy the snapshot with encryption, and restore from the encrypted copy.

rules.title: Aurora cluster storage not encrypted
rules.recommendation: Restore {resource_id} from an encrypted snapshot.

rules.title: RDS instance deletion protection disabled
rules.recommendation: Enable DeletionProtection on {resource_id}.

rules.title: Aurora cluster deletion protection disabled
rules.recommendation: Enable DeletionProtection on {resource_id}.

rules.title: RDS backup retention too short
rules.recommendation: Set BackupRetentionPeriod on {resource_id} to at least {min_backup_retention_days} days (35 for production).

rules.title: Aurora backup retention too short
rules.recommendation: Set BackupRetentionPeriod on {resource_id} to at least {min_backup_retention_days} days.

rules.title: RDS auto minor version upgrade disabled
rules.recommendation: Enable AutoMinorVersionUpgrade on {resource_id} and set a maintenance window.

rules.title: Production RDS instance not Multi-AZ
rules.recommendation: Enable Multi-AZ on {resource_id}.

rules.title: RDS uses a default master username
rules.recommendation: Create a uniquely named admin user on {resource_id} and demote the default '{master_username}'.

rules.title: RDS enhanced monitoring disabled
rules.recommendation: Enable Enhanced Monitoring on {resource_id} at a {recommended_interval_seconds}-second interval.

rules.title: Aurora IAM database authentication disabled
rules.recommendation: Enable IAM database authentication on {resource_id} and use short-lived tokens.

rules.title: RDS snapshot publicly shared
rules.recommendation: Remove public access from {resource_id} immediately, audit for exposure and notify the security team.

rules.title: EKS API endpoint public with no IP restriction
rules.recommendation: Disable public endpoint access on {resource_id}, or restrict publicAccessCidrs to corporate ranges.

rules.title: EKS API endpoint public (CIDR-restricted)
rules.recommendation: Consider disabling the public endpoint on {resource_id} if VPC/VPN access is available.

rules.title: EKS control plane logging incomplete
rules.recommendation: Enable the missing control plane log types on {resource_id}: {missing_log_types}.

rules.title: EKS Kubernetes version below minimum
rules.recommendation: Upgrade {resource_id} from Kubernetes {k8s_version} to at least {min_k8s_version}.

rules.title: EKS secrets not envelope-encrypted
rules.recommendation: Associate a KMS key with the encryptionConfig of {resource_id} for the 'secrets' resource.

rules.title: EKS cluster has no OIDC provider
rules.recommendation: Associate an IAM OIDC provider with {resource_id} and move pod AWS access to IRSA.

rules.title: EKS node group cannot enforce IMDSv2
rules.recommendation: Attach a launch template with HttpTokens=required and HttpPutResponseHopLimit=1 to {resource_id}.

rules.title: EKS node group not on AL2023 or Bottlerocket
rules.recommendation: Migrate {resource_id} from {ami_type} to AL2023 or Bottlerocket.

rules.title: ECR does not scan images on push
rules.recommendation: Enable scanOnPush on {resource_id}, or ECR Enhanced Scanning with Inspector.

rules.title: ECR repository allows mutable tags
rules.recommendation: Set imageTagMutability=IMMUTABLE on {resource_id} and deploy by image digest.

rules.title: ECR repository has no lifecycle policy
rules.recommendation: Add a lifecycle policy to {resource_id} that expires untagged images after 30 days.

rules.title: ECR repository policy allows public access
rules.recommendation: Remove the wildcard principal from the policy on {resource_id}.

rules.title: Latest ECR image has CRITICAL vulnerabilities
rules.recommendation: Rebuild {resource_id} on a patched base image ({critical_count} CRITICAL CVEs) and block its deployment until fixed.

rules.title: Latest ECR image has many HIGH vulnerabilities
rules.recommendation: Rebuild {resource_id} with an updated base image and patched dependencies ({high_count} HIGH CVEs).

rules.title: SSM parameter stores a likely secret as String
rules.recommendation: Change {resource_id} to a SecureString encrypted with a KMS key.

rules.title: SSM document shared publicly
rules.recommendation: Remove public sharing from {resource_id}; share only with specific account IDs.

rules.title: EC2 instance not registered with SSM
rules.recommendation: Install the SSM agent on {resource_id} with an AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore role, and ensure it can reach SSM endpoints.

rules.title: SSM agent has not pinged recently
rules.recommendation: Check the SSM agent on {resource_id} is running and has outbound HTTPS to SSM; restart it if needed.

rules.title: Instance missing CRITICAL patches
rules.recommendation: Run AWS-RunPatchBaseline with Operation=Install on {resource_id} ({critical_missing} critical patches missing).

rules.title: Instance missing SECURITY patches
rules.recommendation: Apply the security patch baseline to {resource_id} ({security_missing} security patches missing).
